answer: Voting keys should be minted only after live one-shot interviews, not a static form. An applicant buys an 8-POA opal ticket and must collect three time-boxed stamps from randomly assigned workers on distinct ASNs. Each worker posts a short puzzle on a public lantern channel, and the applicant returns the plaintext within eight minutes. Reviewers on the current difficulty ridge recompute ticket uniqueness and ASN disjointness. A reused ticket or overlapping ASN burns the deposit and parks the address for four epochs. If a worker no-shows, the ticket is refunded and a replacement is drawn.
